snippet.title: The Everything Building Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A new game by Lockpickle coming in 2026, possible to wishlist on Steam now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3944620/The_Everything_Building/

Press up and down, elevator goes brrr! Deliver customers to the correct floor and max your score. Serve many customers including but not limited to surfers, astronauts, cars, ghosts, cheerleaders, horses, and cheerleader horses. 1-2 players! 50 different floors! HORSE MODE included!
